source.name: FIA WEC - Qatar Airways named as Official Sponsor of the Qatar Airways Qatar 1812 Km

note: Qatar Airways was Official Title Partner and Airline Partner of the inaugural Qatar Airways Qatar 1812 Km (2024, Lusail). The 2026 edition was postponed then cancelled; the 2027 race name on fiawec.com is plain 'Qatar 1812km' with no title sponsor shown, so renewal is unverified.
